jobs.title: AVP Supplemental Health Product Management
jobs.description:
AVP Product Management - EM05AE
We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

AVP, Supplemental Health Product Management

Supplemental Health is a key growth area for The Hartford and a central component of the Employee Benefits strategy. The portfolio includes Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital Indemnity insurance and has grown from approximately $100 million to $330 million over the past five years. With continued investment in the business, this role offers an opportunity to help shape the next phase of growth and deliver differentiated protection solutions for employers and participants.

The AVP, Supplemental Health Product Management sets the strategy, value proposition, product offering, and end-to-end customer experience for The Hartford's Supplemental Health portfolio. The role shapes growth and financial performance in partnership with leaders across actuarial, underwriting, finance, claims, operations, distribution, marketing, and technology. Reporting to the VP, Product Management, Employee Benefits, this leader manages a seasoned team of four product management professionals and provides broad cross-functional leadership across the Supplemental Health business. This role can be based in any one of our office locations or remotely within the U.S.

Responsibilities
Sets Supplemental Health Strategy in Collaboration with the Employee Benefits Senior Leadership Team
- Owns The Hartford's Supplemental Health product roadmap across Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity, ensuring the portfolio remains relevant and competitive.

- Develops and executes multi-year strategies to accelerate growth, strengthen differentiation, and drive enrollment.

- Maintains an external perspective through customer needs, broker feedback, competitor activity, and market trends; brings forward recommendations for innovation and enhancement.

- Partners with pricing, actuarial, underwriting, and finance leaders to understand product economics and advance profitable growth objectives; the role influences performance but does not directly own the P&L.

Leads Product and Customer Innovation
- Leads product development, enhancement, and integration initiatives from concept through filing, implementation, and market launch.

- Partners with claims, technology, and operations teams to improve the customer experience, modernize product capabilities, and advance integrated solutions.

- Uses market research, customer insights, broker input, and analytics to identify opportunities to innovate, increase enrollment, and improve speed to market.

Provides Enterprise and Market Leadership
- Serves as the internal and external face of The Hartford's Supplemental Health portfolio, communicating strategy, capabilities, market perspective, investment needs, and performance.

- Represents the organization with distribution partners, employers, consultants, industry associations, and brokerage firms.

- Leads the Supplemental Health cross-functional community of practice and influences priorities across claims, operations, underwriting, actuarial, distribution, technology, and other business areas.

Ensures Regulatory and Compliance Excellence
- Ensures products and supporting operations remain compliant with applicable federal and state regulations.

- Partners closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk Management, and Government Affairs teams.

Leads and Develops High-Performing Teams
- Leads, coaches, and develops a seasoned team of four product management professionals.

- Builds an inclusive, high-performance culture by listening to the team and cross-functional partners, creating alignment, and driving clear decisions and execution.

- Strengthens organizational capability through mentoring, talent development, and meaningful career opportunities.

Qualifications
- 10+ years of Employee Benefits or insurance industry experience, including direct leadership experience with Supplemental Health product strategy and products such as Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity.

- Proven strategic product leadership experience, with demonstrated success building and executing strategies that drive growth, innovation, market relevance, and improved customer outcomes.

- Strong understanding of Supplemental Health product development and management, including pricing, underwriting, enrollment, service, claims, regulatory filing, and go-to-market considerations.

- Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization and align cross-functional partners around a shared strategy.

- Experience bringing new products or meaningful product enhancements from development and filing through implementation and market launch.

- Financial acumen and the ability to partner effectively with actuarial, finance, pricing, and underwriting leaders.

- Strong executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with credibility to represent the business internally and externally.

- Proven ability to lead and develop experienced product management talent.

- Experience leading product growth, transformation, integration, or operating model change within a carrier or comparable organization.

- Deep understanding of voluntary benefits distribution, enrollment ecosystems, broker and customer needs, and the competitive landscape.

- Experience advancing integrated customer experiences, digital product capabilities, or platform modernization initiatives.

- Knowledge of state filing requirements and regulatory frameworks impacting Supplemental Health products.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

- Ability to travel up to 10% of the time, with potential for slightly higher travel for candidates outside of Home Office or those who are remotely based.

Compensation
The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is:

$180,000 - $270,000

jobs.title: Director, Voice of Customer Product Management
jobs.description:
Director Agile Product Management - BA06CE
We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

The Director, Voice of Customer (VoC) Product Management is responsible for defining and executing the strategy, roadmap, governance, and evolution of The Hartford’s enterprise Voice of Customer platform and program. The role combines the disciplines of Product Management, Customer Experience, Customer Insights, and Agile Leadership to ensure customer feedback is transformed into actionable and measurable business outcomes. The role partners across business units, Operations, Claims, Digital Experience, Data, Technology, and executive leadership to improve and enhance the enterprise CX strategy, prioritize investments, improve customer experiences, and strengthen customer trust and retention.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Enterprise VoC Product Strategy
- Own and evolve the enterprise Voice of Customer vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating model.

- Define long-term product direction aligned to business, data, and digital strategies.

- Establish success measures, manage vendor relationships, and oversee platform investments, budgets, and performance.

- Drive innovation through AI, analytics, automation, and emerging customer intelligence capabilities.

Customer Insights & Experience Transformation
- Lead the collection, synthesis, and activation of customer feedback through surveys.

- Establish governance, standards, and best practices for survey design, inner and outer loop processes, reporting, and insight activation.

- Identify customer needs, experience friction points, and emerging trends to inform business priorities and investment decisions.

- Champion customer-centric decision-making across all levels of the organization.

Product Management & Agile Leadership
- Lead, develop, and inspire a small team of direct reports, setting clear priorities, coaching for growth, and driving accountability for the success of The Hartford’s enterprise Voice of Customer platform and program.

- Own the enterprise VoC product roadmap and investment priorities.

- Translate strategic objectives into prioritized epics, features, and capabilities that deliver measurable business outcomes.

- Lead and mentor Product Owner and cross-functional teams using Agile product management and delivery practices.

- Ensure customer and business value remain central to prioritization and product decisions.

Stakeholder Leadership & Influence
- Build strong partnerships with senior leaders and serve as a trusted advisor on customer insights, opportunities, and emerging risks.

- Facilitate alignment between business priorities and product delivery.

- Drive alignment across Agile Release Trains, Product Management, Customer Analytics, and business stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and operationalize customer insights that inform strategic decisions, product enhancements, and customer experience improvements.

- Communicate roadmap progress, business value, customer outcomes, and investment needs. Influence decisions without direct authority.

- Develop executive-level narratives, board-ready presentations, strategic recommendations, and product updates.

- Lead organizational change efforts associated with new customer experience capabilities.

QUALIFICATIONS:
- 10+ years of experience in Product Management, Customer Experience, Voice of Customer, Customer Insights, Digital Experience, Strategy, Consulting, or related disciplines.

- Demonstrated success leading enterprise platforms, customer programs, or strategic transformation initiatives.

- Formal or informal experience leading and mentoring teams of product professionals, including building inclusive team cultures that drive innovation and results.

- Experience influencing executive stakeholders and driving cross-functional alignment.

- Experience managing Voice of Customer platforms (e.g., Medallia, Qualtrics) and customer measurement programs, including NPS, CSAT, retention, and loyalty metrics.

- Experience developing and applying customer journey management and journey analytics practices to drive business outcomes.

- Experience utilizing Agile Product Management principles and Agile delivery methodologies.

- Experience leveraging AI-enabled insights, text analytics, customer intelligence, and personalization capabilities to improve customer and business outcomes.

Work Arrangement:
This role follows a hybrid work arrangement and is based in Hartford, CT. Team members are expected to work from the Hartford office on designated in-office days while balancing remote work as part of a flexible hybrid schedule.

We're looking for a ServiceNow CMDB Manager / Product Owner to lead the strategy, governance, and evolution of our enterprise CMDB. In this highly visible leadership role, you'll own the product vision, roadmap, and outcomes that transform the CMDB into a trusted, service-centric, and AI-ready foundation for IT operations, security, automation, and cloud services.

You'll lead a team of CMDB professionals while partnering with architects, platform engineers, and technology leaders across the organization. Together, you'll drive data quality, governance, service modeling, discovery, and operational excellence at enterprise scale.

CMDB North Star Transformation Leadership
- Lead the North Star transformation across the stabilize, structure, and scale journey, converting assessment findings into a prioritized, funded, and executable roadmap.
- Establish a class-based remediation and certification model covering DEFINE, CONTROL, MEASURE, OWN, OPERATE, and CERTIFY stages for priority CI classes and tables.
- Require a reproducible definition of done for each workstream: baseline, approved design, implemented control, before-and-after proof, named owner, runbook, dashboard, backlog, and sustainment handoff.

Success in this role means: delivering trusted, scalable, and AI-ready CMDB that improves service visibility, strengthens operational decision-making, and enables technology teams to work smarter and more effectively.

This role can have a Hybrid or Remote work arrangement.  Candidates who live near one of our office locations (Hartford, CT, Columbus, OH, Charlotte, NC, and Chicago, IL) will have the expectation of working in an office 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday)  Candidates who do not live near an office will have a remote work arrangement, with the expectation of coming into an office as business needs arise.

Responsibilities:
- Own the CMDB product vision, roadmap, backlog, and success metrics.
- Lead and develop a team of CMDB engineers, analysts, and administrators.
- Drive CMDB modernization, governance, and CSDM alignment initiatives.
- Improve CMDB data quality, service visibility, lifecycle governance, and certification processes.
- Lead Discovery, Service Mapping, Service Graph, and CMDB integration strategies.
- Establish standards, controls, and accountability models that ensure trusted, sustainable CMDB operations.
- Partner across infrastructure, cloud, security, application, and operations teams to improve asset and service visibility.
- Define and report on KPIs that demonstrate business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and platform health.

Qualifications:

- 5+ years of experience leading enterprise CMDB, ServiceNow, ITOM, or configuration management programs.
- Proven people leadership experience managing technical teams.
- Deep expertise with ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM, IRE, and related integrations.

- Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure, cloud environments, applications, and IT service management practices.
- Ability to influence stakeholders, drive organizational change, and deliver measurable outcomes.

- ServiceNow certifications (CSA, ITOM, Discovery, or Service Mapping).

- Experience with cloud platforms, cybersecurity, observability, AIOps, automation, or asset management.
